title: Logging Framework (Chain of Responsibility + Strategy)
summary: The classic 'design a logger': levels, a chain of handlers with their own thresholds, pluggable formatters, failure isolation and thread safety.
hints: There are two filters: the logger's level (checked first, cheap) and each handler's own minimum level.
Formatting is a Strategy (`Formatter`) injected into each handler, so the same message can go to the console as text and to a file as JSON.
Treat the handlers as a chain where every handler gets a look. One handler throwing must not stop the rest.
Concurrent logging: the memory handler's sink is shared, so make `handle` synchronized (Java) or guard it with a mutex (Go).
